caption: The drawing features a mostly blank, off-white or light beige background with a thin rectangular border drawn slightly inside the edges of the paper. Near the center of the composition, there is a small, circular object that appears to be a rendered impression of a medallion or stamp. The object is shaded in gray tones to represent a three-dimensional, metallic look and includes visible text arranged in lines around the center. The text reads "CRESCENT SILVER MFG. TRIPLE PLATE" in uppercase letters. In the bottom left corner outside the rectangular border, the name "CARMEL WILSON" is lightly written in small letters. The overall color palette consists of different shades of gray and off-white.
title: Trademark for Flagon
